issues: Dev-only React hydration warning: <option> contains an injected <span> wrapper (from Emergent x-* instrumentation attributes). Not a user-facing bug; may be ignored. If instrumentation can skip <option> children it would silence the warning.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 730 lines; consider splitting into routers (payments, auth, monitoring, media) for maintainability.

finalize_adoption raises HTTPException from webhook path (apply_midtrans_status) and is caught in /payments/notification but still mutates adoption to paid_conflict - good; just log context including coral_id and amount for audit.
/api/media reads full object into memory even for Range requests; for large videos consider streaming (httpx stream + StreamingResponse) and passing Range through to storage.
requests.put in put_object uses sync requests inside async endpoint - OK because wrapped with asyncio.to_thread; keep the pattern consistent.
payment_notification responds 200 even when adoption not found which is correct (idempotent); keep but add structured log.
